brand_names: Some By Mi AHA BHA PHA
purpose: This product is a gentle skin essence designed to help treat and prevent milia, which are those tiny white bumps that can appear on your face. It works to smooth your skin and unclog pores by softening the buildup of dead skin cells. It can also help improve overall skin texture and give your complexion a clearer, more even appearance.
how_it_works: Salicylic acid is an ingredient that gently dissolves the 'glue' that holds dead skin cells together on the surface of your skin. Because it can get into your pores, it helps loosen the trapped keratin — the protein that causes milia — and lets it clear out naturally. Over time, this stops new bumps from forming and helps existing ones fade away.
common_side_effects: Some people may notice mild dryness, flaking, or slight redness when they first start using it, especially if your skin is sensitive. You might also feel a mild tingling or stinging sensation when you apply it. These effects usually settle down after your skin adjusts within the first week or two.
warnings: Do not use this product on broken, irritated, or sunburned skin. Salicylic acid can make your skin more sensitive to the sun, so always apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day while using this product. Avoid getting it near your eyes, mouth, or nostrils. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, check with your doctor before using salicylic acid regularly. Stop using it and consult a healthcare provider if you develop severe redness, peeling, or a rash.
typical_dosing: Apply a small amount of the essence to clean, dry skin once daily, preferably in the evening. Use a cotton pad or your fingertips to gently pat it onto the areas with milia or where you tend to get them. Let it absorb fully before applying your moisturizer. Start with every other day if your skin is sensitive, then build up to daily use as your skin gets used to it.
